Merge 3a88d1801b6b3ad6453d9d7a6a50e59a05942da4 into eb4bbabafeb10bce11c78d1adc12007f6dd831ee

fix(edit): a placement's session state ends at the next load of the config that dropped it

Whatever removes a placement (a hand edit, another session's click, a
change made while the daemon was down), every session's state for it ends
at the next load of its config, so a re-added id opens with its libraries
closed, nothing configured and no drafts.

The key's minter says which placement a key belongs to, and one rule
releases every key whose placement the loaded config no longer holds,
measured before unplaced placements are dropped. The render cache runs it
on every successful load over the sessions whose last click acted in that
config. A clicking session's own release goes through the click's journal,
so undo restores its drafts. A failed load releases nothing, and author
menus are never touched. The daemon log names each release.

fix(git): an ask that fails other than by an exit is the read's result as it stands (a623)
fix(git): a failed ask is a read that never started; the ask runs in the read's directory; forge reads unset GH_REPO (a623)

fix(git): a git or forge read unsets the repository variables of the shell that spawned the daemon (a623)

Every git read, forge CLI launch and the doctor's forge probe now launch
through one asker that unsets the variables `git rev-parse
--local-env-vars` names, asked of git once. The daemon's environment is
the spawning shell's, so a hook's or vcsh's GIT_DIR pointed every
session's read at that shell's repository. An ask that fails is the
read's own failed launch, never a read with the variables.
